current_known_readers: All readers of this repository, including fixture authors and development agents, can inspect candidate holdout prompts, expected facts and source snapshots.
required_destination: A D-controlled repository or private evaluation store whose access policy excludes development authors and their agents; do not grant new access from this checkout.
required_evidence_before_qualification: Name the actual independent D custodian and authorized reviewers.
Record destination identity, effective access policy and a negative read-access check from a development identity.
D must independently assess prior exposure and replace any exposed tasks/answer keys before treating a corpus as an unseen holdout.
Transfer exact source bytes, task/answer-key manifests and frozen checksums through an owner-authorized channel; record the transfer receipt and D verification.
Freeze model/prompt revision, output IDs, resource ceilings and human acceptance rubric before generating heldout outputs.
Keep answer keys and human review decisions outside developer-visible model inputs and repositories.
Only independently reviewed follow-up implementation may enable evaluation against the genuinely segregated corpus. A local JSON receipt or chmod is insufficient.
